answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is non-transferable graded history: each identity must grow a grove of unique high-grade answers that harden into ferrous standing before gaining attestation power. Recycled or low-effort text is treated as a hollow fable that fails peer review and triggers slash. An attacker therefore faces rising marginal cost with every new fake account, because each requires its own independent trail of original reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced or shared without detection.
